    SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN mtx_drugs md ON de.drug_concept_id = md.concept_id
    WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY de.person_id
),
alt_window AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fm.person_id,
           CASE WHEN m.value_as_number > 2.0 * m.range_high THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS alt_gt_2x_uln
    FROM first_mtx fm
    JOIN omop.measurement m
      ON m.person_id = fm.person_id
     AND m.measurement_date >= fm.index_date
     AND m.measurement_date <= DATEADD(day, 60, fm.index_date)
    WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3006923, 3005755, 3027388, 46236949, 46235106)
      AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
      AND m.range_high IS NOT NULL
      AND m.range_high > 0
),
per_person AS (
    SELECT fm.person_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN aw.alt_gt_2x_uln = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_alt_gt_2x_uln,
           MAX(CASE WHEN aw.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_alt_test
    FROM first_mtx fm
    LEFT JOIN alt_window aw ON fm.person_id = aw.person_id
    GROUP BY fm.person_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_mtx_users,
       SUM(has_alt_test) AS users_with_alt_result_in_60d,
       SUM(has_alt_gt_2x_uln) AS users_with_alt_gt_2x_uln_in_60d,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(has_alt_gt_2x_uln) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS pct_of_all_new_users,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(has_alt_gt_2x_uln) / NULLIF(SUM(has_alt_test), 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS pct_among_users_with_alt_result
FROM per_person;

SELECT m.measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(m.value_as_number) AS n_numeric, COUNT(m.range_high) AS n_range_high
FROM omop.measurement m
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = m.measurement_concept_id
WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3006923,3005755,3027388,46236949,46235106,1761617)
GROUP BY m.measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name
ORDER BY n DESC;
